## Notes

Asobo Studio, Xbox Game Studios; Windows 2020-08-18, VR 2020-12-22, Xbox Series 2021-07-27; Bing Maps terrain updated every 28 days; Azure AI 3D generation streamed from cloud, over two petabytes; Meteoblue live weather; live air traffic; physics simulates over 1,000 control surfaces and wind over terrain; legacy flight model option; marketplace.
